## 4. Key Enterprise Projects (Under NDA / Enterprise Intranet)

### Project 1: Vocational Skills-Training Exam Platform (بخش آزمون پلتفرم مهارت‌آموزی فنی و حرفه‌ای)
- Role: Technical Project Manager & Scrum Lead
- Tech Stack: Angular, C# .NET Core, SQL Server, Clean Architecture, High Concurrency, Scrum
- Engineering Challenge:
  The platform faced sudden, massive traffic surges with tens of thousands of concurrent examinees submitting answers simultaneously. Zero tolerance for lost answers, submission latency, or database deadlocks.
- Solution & Architecture:
  Engineered a distributed tiered architecture using C# .NET Core and Angular. Introduced layered in-memory caching for question retrieval and asynchronous task queues for submission buffering. Optimized SQL Server isolation levels to eliminate table contention.
- Key Metrics & Verifiable Impact:
  - Sustained 50,000+ concurrent examinees nationwide.
  - Achieved 99.98% system uptime during live exam windows.
  - 0% lost submissions.

### Project 2: Moghan Agro-Industry Comprehensive Financial System (سامانه مالی کشت و صنعت و دامپروری مغان)
- Role: Technical Project Manager & Software Architect
- Tech Stack: .NET Core, Angular, SQL Server, Stimulsoft Reports, Financial Accounting Modules
- Engineering Challenge:
  Consolidating disparate accounting and cost-center workflows across multiple expansive agro-industrial divisions into a unified, audit-proof double-entry ledger.
- Solution & Architecture:
  Designed a domain-centric Clean Architecture using .NET Core and Angular. Structured highly normalized, indexed SQL Server databases to ensure ACID compliance on high-volume journal entries, and automated financial statements with Stimulsoft Reports.
- Key Metrics & Verifiable Impact:
  - Processed 100,000+ financial transaction documents annually.
  - Accelerated month-end reporting and reconciliation by 40%.

### Project 3: Oil Products Distribution Warehouse Management System (سامانه انبارداری شرکت فرآورده‌های نفتی)
- Role: Senior Full-Stack Developer
- Tech Stack: C#, .NET Core, SQL Server, RESTful API, Stimulsoft Reports, Inventory Ledger
- Engineering Challenge:
  High-security petroleum product depots require instantaneous, accurate ledger reconciliation with zero margin for quantity discrepancies or delayed inventory updates.
- Solution & Architecture:
  Built high-performance C# .NET Core Web APIs and fine-tuned SQL Server query execution plans. Enforced strict transactional boundaries for stock movement and integrated Stimulsoft automated dispatch and discrepancy reporting.
- Key Metrics & Impact:
  - Sub-300ms inventory search and stock retrieval response times.
  - 100% audit reconciliation across strategic depot locations.

### Project 4: Public Sector Employment Administration System (سامانه اداره استخدامی)
- Role: Senior Full-Stack Developer
- Tech Stack: Angular, TypeScript, C# .NET, SQL Server, Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
- Engineering Challenge:
  Safeguarding confidential applicant information, accommodating complex multi-stage recruitment scoring rubrics, and providing a snappy evaluation interface for review boards.
- Solution & Architecture:
  Developed modular Angular and TypeScript components with reactive state management, backed by hardened C# .NET services featuring granular Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) and audit trails.
- Key Metrics & Impact:
  - 50% turnaround acceleration in applicant evaluations.
  - Secure end-to-end applicant tracking with role-based data isolation.

### Project 5: "Training 500 Young & Efficient Managers" Nationwide Examination System (آزمون طرح تربیت ۵۰۰ مدیر جوان و کارآمد)
- Role: Project Manager & Operations Lead
- Tech Stack: Angular, .NET Core, SQL Server, High Concurrency, Scrum
- Engineering Challenge:
  High-stakes national executive selection requiring absolute test integrity, resilience against client connection drops, and immediate psychometric and technical grade tabulation.
- Solution & Architecture:
  Conducted rigorous pre-flight load and stress tests, implemented client-side answer caching with background heartbeat synchronization, and managed sprint workflows for operational readiness.
- Key Metrics & Impact:
  - 100% zero-downtime execution on exam day.
  - Instant automated scoring and competency grade generation upon submission.
